defects.evidence: proposal _post/_chain vs reference_source _rebind_adapter_trace (typed patch.journal / patch.core updates + hash rebind); obligation_spec.limitations: true t.trace_event/restore shape not in supplied sources
defects.reason: Recovered-state heuristics (_post STATE_KEYS/PATCH_KEYS and shallow dict(prev,**patch)) are not evidenced against retained typed traces; reference adapter events are before_sha256/patch/after_sha256 with nested journal/core patches, so shallow merge can replace whole subtrees or return missing and leave controls unapplied.

defects.evidence: proposal _is_adapter; obligation_spec.findings F4 (implement exact set vs control-build subset); a_audit exact ledger cited in packet
defects.reason: Witness predicate _is_adapter still accepts journal supersets (set(JOURNAL)<=keys), reproducing obligation F4’s control-build gap; 'any' sites may be chosen on already-invalid journals, and exact inventory is only planted—not required—for reachability.

defects.evidence: SPECS generation-advance-without-restart wants=('nonrestart',); _want restart vs restart-invoked; obligation_spec.findings F3 (expected=int(verb=='source-restart') ignoring q_invoked)
defects.reason: No planted control for F3’s specific false-pass: source-restart with q_invoked false plus generation +1; generation-advance uses only 'nonrestart', so verb-only inspector bugs on non-invoked restart remain unprobed.

defects.evidence: proposal charge.take sites; obligation_spec.limitations recovery uncharged; reference_source durable_precharge + LocalControlCounter exact limits
defects.reason: Charge accounting covers _site prefixes, _apply, and _call only; full _chain/_post recovery work is uncharged, weaker and less conservative than reference durable full-plan precharge.

defects.evidence: proposal run_controls/SPECS lack MAX_*; reference_source MAX_INPUT/MAX_JSON/HISTORIES and require() gates
defects.reason: No explicit input/enumeration bounds (case count, events, rows, payload size); reference enforces MAX_* and finite ordinals—failure under huge or malformed retained cases is unspecified.

defects.evidence: obligation_spec.dissent raw!=journal vs typed _exact; reference RETAINED_LABELS typed-action-tuple-loss; proposal journal-drift appends tuple
defects.reason: Encoding/determinism dissent (tuple vs list after JSON) is not covered; mutations append tuples and _safe listifies for reports only—no typed-action/tuple-loss style control.

defects.evidence: proposal has run_controls only; reference_source __main__ REFUSED + injected durable_precharge/auditors
defects.reason: Module can be imported/executed as a normal library; reference refuses bare __main__ execution and demands wrapper-injected callables.

required_checks: Against real check.py run_history / typed certificate events: confirm whether post-states are embedded or only patches+hashes; replace _post/_chain with the evidenced format (or reject heuristic recovery).
Require exact journal key equality for adapter witnesses (and/or only accept cases already status-supported) before planting journal-extra / journal-drift.
Add a reachable control: verb source-restart ∧ q_invoked is False ∧ planted generation +1; assert correct inspector → counterexample, verb-only inspector → escape.
Measure or precharge recovery+inspection work; align with an explicit reservation plan comparable to reference durable_precharge.
Bound cases/events/rows/payload sizes and define conservative failure (unproved/not_applicable) on overflow or unreadable carriers.
Static cross-check JOURNAL 12-tuple and +1-on-success / restart-generation rules against s_domain EXTRA, s_inclusive, a_inclusive, a_audit without executing models.
reservations: No tools, execution, or admission; scientific_status remains BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED; origin_acceptance is false.
Packet claims about implement/control-build line behavior and fixture outcomes were not re-verified from filesystem sources—only from embedded obligation_spec text.
If retained traces are typed patches as in boundary_controls, most SPECS may systematically report missing-witness/unapplied and force status unproved without proving inspector discrimination.

Controls validate an injected inspect_cases, not a closed proof of the revision-ledger obligation; interop with a still-defective inspector (F1–F4) is intentional but readiness depends on pairing with a repaired checker.
strengths: No imports of models/reducers/guards; inspector and charge are injected parameters.
detected is True only on inspector status=='counterexample'; raises and non-counterexample statuses are not promoted; missing-witness stays unexercised → unproved.
SPECS cover several packet defect classes: skip/phantom revision, journal drift, undeclared journal key, generation freeze on invoked restart, phantom q_invoked, dropped trailing row.
_chain appends None on recovery failure (unlike implement _states compression called out in F1), reducing false index alignment when recovery returns missing.
Docstring frames 'supported' as audited-prefix discrimination, not a theorem.
review.summary: Static review only: the proposal is a self-contained inspector-mutation harness aimed at o10 revision-ledger defects, but its event-recovery and adapter-witness predicates are not evidenced against the typed retained-trace shape in the reference, so several SPECS are likely unexercised or mis-sited; treat as repair, not lead-ready.
